name: Biomedical and Veterinary Medical Sciences PhD
detailsNote: Official umbrella information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed. Department-specific requirements differ. All checked application instructions select Pathobiological Sciences; confirm the appropriate departmental selection with LSU. Admission routes differ: PBS allows rotations, whereas VCS requires prior laboratory acceptance; no single umbrella admission model is asserted.

publishedDeadlines.label: PBS early nominated fellowship
publishedDeadlines.note: Undated PBS fall table; not a common deadline for all departments.

english.note: Central alternatives PTE59 / Michigan English53 (B2). TOEFL/IELTS valid two years, single sitting, no superscoring. Exemptions require qualifying US degree, listed primary-English-country degree, or qualifying country of origin and official documentation; program may set higher requirements.

applicationFee.note: International fee; domestic fee $50. Central waivers exclude international applicants. Some departments offer selective discount codes; availability here is not confirmed.

requirements.note: PBS: bachelor's US/equivalent, GPA3.0, no veterinary training required; contact faculty encouraged, not required, fellowship students may rotate three labs or enter sponsored lab. VCS: bachelor's or DVM, GPA3.0, faculty must accept applicant into laboratory before admission considered; initiate at least six months before entry. VCS's linked 2020 handbook requires GRE300 combined verbal/quantitative (within five years); current page does not restate this, so confirm. VCS competitive aid differs from PBS.

funding.note: Current PBS page says all admitted students receive full stipend; its older linked guidelines say stipend cannot be guaranteed, so confirm an award in the offer. VCS states stipends/fellowships/assistantships for non-residency master's and doctoral students are competitive. These claims do not establish universal funding across the umbrella.
